note: Evidence abridged by the author from the critic's full report; verdicts and preference verbatim.
reads_as_reason: Boxy head, very wide splayed shoulders and arms, a visibly short neck and tube-like legs read as a stout character figure.

G1.evidence: Squared-off head, short neck (P2a 0.1103); heavy splayed arm slabs (P3 0.418); straight leg columns, long wedge foot (P10a 0.238).

G2.evidence: Chest, waist band and pelvis bowl read as stacked pieces; thigh and shank near-parallel tubes (P8a 0.9375, P8b 0.9705). Dark bands deliberate, forms between them do not connect.

G3.evidence: White shells, graphite bands at waist, elbow, knee, wrist, gloss visor, no accent; regular bands with none of the baseline's smears.

G4.evidence: Head and chest tight-radius boxes; arms and pelvis pillowy; domed shoulders; soft-rectangle legs; flat wedge foot.

G6.evidence: Head height matches and the white-over-graphite layering follows the brief; shoulders far wider than both references, no hourglass, short neck, untapered legs, long foot. IoU 0.5248 / 0.5566.

pairwise.evidence: Both toy-like; the candidate is cleaner: integrated domed shoulders, regular dark bands, torso and pelvis read as one body, no ragged black patches (baseline shoulder panel and forearm smear); S4b 0.5141 vs 0.6473. Baseline has slightly better leg taper (P8a 0.8648 vs 0.9375).

top_changes.change: Narrow the shoulders and arm slabs so the arms hang inside the leg width; shrink the shoulder dome, then the upper-arm section.
Taper thigh and shank (thigh wide at the hip, ~65 % area at the knee; shank widest just below the knee).
Lengthen the visible neck and soften the head corners.

notes: Two-tone render is flat; no true back or top view; the pairwise rests on finish and flow since numeric pass counts are equal (12 of 19).
